description: This Python script implements a client tool for interacting with an Intel DSP server, capable of sending commands, uploading firmware, and monitoring logs.

classes.name: cavstool_client
classes.description: A client class for communicating with the DSP server, capable of sending commands, uploading firmware, and monitoring logs.

methods.name: send_cmd
methods.description: Sends a command to the server and handles the response, initiating log monitoring or firmware upload based on acknowledgment.

methods.name: uploading
methods.description: Uploads firmware file to the server, including computing MD5 and sending a structured header.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Initiates firmware upload using the provided firmware file argument.

methods.name: monitor_log
methods.description: Continuously receives and outputs log data from the server.

methods.name: __del__
methods.description: Closes the socket connection when the client object is destroyed.
